column1: # The receiver each class's rows are sent to in corpus/collection-arity.tsv's
# probe, and the second collection its set operations take (Phase 5g Task 0b).
# class<TAB>setup, statements separated by ` | `, which must leave `r` holding
# the receiver, `other` a second collection of the same class, and `ka`/`va`
# an index and an item that are IN `r`.
# `ka` and `va` are variables and not literals on purpose: IdentityTable
# compares indexes by identity, so a second literal of the same spelling is
# not guaranteed to be the object that was stored.
# THE SETUP IS THE RICHEST RECEIVER THE ORACLE CAN BUILD, not the richest both
# sides can. A class whose store this crate does not have fails here rather
# than at the send, and the probe reports that as `setup-differs` -- which is
# the phase's headline measurement and not a harness fault.

column2: ka = 1 | va = 'z' | r = .Array~of('a','b','c') | r[1] = va | other = .Array~of('c','d')
